entries.7bb1d864e77b29b4: Its business segment is a single segment, the contract conclusion support business. The breakdown by area of revenue of ¥29,100 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥13,853 million for the energy area, ¥10,566 million for the human resources area, and ¥4,680 million for the new and other areas. In the energy area, it is considered to be the largest-scale operator in Japan, with a track record of support of about 900,000 or more cases per year in contract conclusion support for electricity, gas, and other services, and revenue from a major customer group accounting for 10% or more of revenue (energy area, name not disclosed) was ¥8,549 million.
